title: Firebase Secure Wallet Rules
description: Generate secure Firebase rules to protect wallet balances and prevent tampering.
prompt_text: Act as a senior Firebase Security Architect. Create production-grade Firestore Security Rules for a wallet system where users can only read their own balance, cannot directly modify wallet values, cannot create negative balances, cannot increase funds without verified server-side transactions, and all updates must be validated through Cloud Functions. Provide Firestore Rules, Cloud Function validation logic, attack prevention measures, fraud scenarios, and recommended database structure.

title: Ad Network Fallback Logic
description: Build a multi-network ad monetization architecture with automatic fallback.
prompt_text: Act as a senior Capacitor and Ad Monetization Engineer. Design a production-ready architecture where AdMob is the primary ad network and AppLovin, Unity Ads, and other networks act as automatic fallbacks. Include JavaScript code structure, provider abstraction layer, remote configuration strategy, mediation logic, failover mechanisms, analytics tracking, revenue optimization techniques, and Capacitor integration examples.

title: Real-Time Payment Sync
description: Create a live payment synchronization system between merchant and customer apps.
prompt_text: Act as a backend architect. Design a real-time payment synchronization system between a Shopkeeper App and Customer App using UPI. Include database schema, webhook handling, transaction lifecycle, real-time updates via WebSockets or Firebase, payment verification logic, retry mechanisms, fraud prevention, reconciliation process, and sample backend APIs.

title: Gemini API Integration
description: Generate clean Gemini Flash API integration code.
prompt_text: Act as a senior JavaScript developer. Create a clean and production-ready Gemini Flash API integration for a web application. Include API setup, secure key handling, streaming responses, error handling, retry logic, loading indicators, conversation memory, and optimized JavaScript code examples.

title: Offline Data Handling
prompt_text: Act as an offline-first application architect. Design a system where user actions continue working without internet access. Store data locally, queue pending operations, detect connectivity restoration, sync automatically to the cloud, resolve conflicts, prevent duplication, and provide complete JavaScript implementation guidance.

title: 30-Day WhatsApp Broadcast Strategy
description: Generate a complete WhatsApp content calendar for local businesses.
prompt_text: Act as a WhatsApp marketing strategist. Create a 30-day WhatsApp Broadcast Calendar for a [insert business type]. For each day provide image concept, caption, CTA, engagement objective, festival tie-ins, promotional ideas, and customer retention strategy. Optimize for local Indian audiences.

title: No-Text Reel Concept Generator
description: Create viral reel concepts that rely only on visuals.
prompt_text: Act as a viral Instagram strategist. Generate 20 no-text Instagram Reel concepts for [insert product or niche]. Each concept must communicate the message entirely through visuals, transitions, sound effects, pacing, camera movement, expressions, and editing style without using any on-screen text.

title: Local Festival Campaign
description: Create a teaser campaign around a local festival promotion.
prompt_text: Act as a local marketing expert. Design a 3-phase social media campaign around [insert festival]. Include teaser posts, countdown strategy, offer reveal content, visual concepts, hashtags, WhatsApp messages, Instagram stories, and conversion-focused CTAs.

title: Viral Hook Creator
prompt_text: Act as a short-form video growth expert. Generate 50 scroll-stopping hooks for [insert product/service]. Focus on curiosity, surprise, emotion, controversy, urgency, relatability, and pattern interruption. Optimize for the first 3 seconds of Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

title: Community Engagement Polls
description: Create daily engagement questions and polls.
prompt_text: Act as a community growth strategist. Generate 100 interactive poll ideas, questions, challenges, and mini-games for a WhatsApp Channel or Group focused on [insert niche]. Maximize engagement, participation, retention, and conversation quality.

title: Government Scheme Pitch
description: Create trust-building outreach messages for government-linked services.
prompt_text: Act as a sales copywriter specializing in government-related services. Write a trust-building WhatsApp outreach message for [insert scheme or service]. Focus on credibility, transparency, eligibility awareness, benefits, and a low-pressure CTA that encourages response.

title: Objection Handling Script
prompt_text: Act as a high-ticket sales trainer. Create an objection handling script for the statement: 'Your charges are higher than competitors.' Include empathy, value reframing, ROI explanation, trust-building examples, and multiple conversational responses for different client personalities.

title: Dead-Lead Revival Text
description: Reactivate cold prospects who stopped responding.
prompt_text: Act as a customer re-engagement expert. Create 20 short WhatsApp messages to revive leads who have not responded for 2 months. Use friendly, low-pressure language, curiosity, relevance, and personalized follow-up techniques.

title: Free Consultation Hook
description: Generate ad copy for consultation-based lead generation.
prompt_text: Act as a Facebook Ads copywriter. Create ad copy designed to generate bookings for a free 10-minute consultation related to [insert service]. Include primary text, headline, CTA, audience targeting suggestions, and multiple ad angles.

title: High-Ticket Proposal Structure
description: Create a one-page proposal that highlights ROI.
prompt_text: Act as a business proposal specialist. Create a one-page high-ticket proposal framework for [insert service]. Include client challenges, solution overview, implementation process, expected outcomes, ROI projections, trust indicators, pricing presentation, and closing CTA.
